passage: Rohtas Fort, near the city of Jhelum in Pakistan, was built in the 1540s to control an important route through the hills. The massive stone walls of the fort ______ for about four kilometers, and twelve gates allow travelers to pass through them. Today the fort is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The subject of the verb is "walls," which is plural; "of the fort" only tells whose walls they are. A plural subject needs a plural verb, so "stretch" is correct.
explanation.A: Incorrect. "Stretches" is singular and seems to agree with "fort," but the subject is the plural "walls."
explanation.B: Correct. The plural verb "stretch" agrees with the plural subject "walls."
explanation.C: Incorrect. "Is stretching" is singular, but the subject "walls" is plural.
explanation.D: Incorrect. "Has stretched" is singular, but the subject "walls" is plural.
